{{Quote|''[R2-D2 beeps]<br />"''Stroke its belly and it will fall asleep? Must I?|quotestart=0|R2-D2 and C-3PO|<ref name="Shiny" />}}
A giant [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] '''serpent''' lived on a terrestrial [[Unidentified planet (space crystals)|planet]]. When lifting its upper body vertically, it could reach the height of<ref name="Shiny" /> a 1.7-[[Meter/Legends|meters]]-tall [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|3PO-series protocol droid]].<ref name="Height" /> The [[Snake/Legends|snake]] was covered in [[Color/Legends|red]] scales, and it had a row of crests running along the top of its body. It had yellow [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and a red-colored split [[Tongue/Legends|tongue]]. When the creature's [[Stomach/Legends|belly]] was stroked it would fall [[Sleep/Legends|asleep]].<ref name="Shiny" />

At one point, the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and the [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] visited the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] inhabited by the giant serpent. The two [[Droid/Legends|droids]] undertook a trip to try and locate a source of [[space crystal]]s needed for their [[Unidentified gold spacecraft|starship]]; however, one of the serpents blocked their way on a narrow [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] pass. While the creature observed the pair with its body raised upward, R2-D2 informed C-3PO how to make it fall asleep. Initially hesitant, the protocol droid ultimately put the serpent asleep, after which the droid pair continued on their journey.<ref name="Shiny" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Are ''you'' brave enough to stroke the serpent's belly?|''Shiny as a Droid'', addressing the reader|<ref name="Shiny" />}}
The serpent appeared in [[Shiny as a Droid: Things to See, Touch, and Smell from a Galaxy Far, Far Away|''Shiny as a Droid'']], a [[1986]] children's book written by [[Virginia Holt]] and illustrated by [[Feito]]. The serpent's belly is one of the interactive elements in the book that the reader can scratch.<ref name="Shiny" />
